_note: Synthetic Phase 2 service-desk tickets for Litware Legal (invented client; B-21). Shaped like a PSA export (Autotask-like ticket fields: source, status, created, updated). subject and body are free text from the requester (untrusted); requester, affected_user and technician are form fields. labels are the gold answers a lead would give and are never shown to the code under test (STD-FX-5). Times are UTC and pinned to as_of. Every person, patient, investor, client, account number (00- prefix), SSN-shaped string (000- area, never issued) and phone number (555-01xx) is invented. Fixture-based, not real tickets.
